text: Why did nobody in our village go near the beach after dark? Because every night, something walked out of the sea.
Leave the slippers. It can have the slippers!
I should've bought a bigger pot.
Arun! Grab the rope!
Back! The wall's coming down!
They called until sunrise. Arun never answered.
At dawn, the whole village went looking for Arun. We found the monster first.
How long has your family been doing this?
Granddad built the first one. Dad added the roar.
And you?
I made it louder.
The government seized his fortune and divided it among the villagers. We used Arun's share to build him a statue. Without him, we'd still be locking our doors.
He'd have asked for the cash.
Is that seaweed? In the snow?
He built another one.
That thing's... breathing.
Why is there a statue of me?
You're freezing. Where have you been?
The wave swept me out. He kept me in a cave until I could walk.
Arun... why can't I see your breath?
He didn't save me. He sent me. To open the doors.
That's why nobody in our village goes near the beach after dark. There's nobody left in our village. I'm the only one who locked my door.
